name: DOCX Generator
description: Generates a Word document from an uploaded .docx template. Placeholders in the template use {field_name} syntax matching project field names. Adds a button on the data entry form that fills the template with current form values (choice fields are exported as labels).

project-settings.name: Instrument on which the button is shown (leave empty = all instruments)
Field used as filename prefix (e.g. record identifier)

JSON fields (advanced): text/notes fields whose value is a JSON array of objects, e.g. populated by a custom widget or via the API — each item will be rendered as one line in the document. Leave empty if you don't use this pattern.
